concept: Owner-resolved firstwinning paths as π-frequency Fourier wave of discrete time-derivative of cumulative original K4-win existence, not player defense obligation.

mathematics.monotoneBinaryWave: B_t=1 if any actual player K4 has appeared along t hypothetical moves, else0; B0=0, B_t nondecreasing even beyond counterfactual firstwinner because original stones immutable.
mathematics.firstWinImpulse: f_t=B_t-B_(t-1) ∈{0,1}, at most one nonzero t
mathematics.naturalOwnerPhase: epsilon_t=(-1)^(32+t-1): +1 for original P0 mover, -1 for P1
mathematics.firstWinnerContrast: SUM_t epsilon_t*f_t is exactly +1 P0 FIRST WIN / -1 P1 FIRST WIN / 0 DRAW along any original same-schedule real truncated game
mathematics.ordinaryComplexFirstWinImpulseFourier: If firstwinner local t=tau, F_f(omega)=exp(-i omega tau); all other frequencies have unit modulus, draw gives0
mathematics.physicalWaveInterpretation: This is classical Fourier character sum of rule-grounded time alternation; no physical quantum interference postulate or strategic WDL inferred.

scope: Mathematical original firstwin timing wave under one fixed uniformly weighted HYPOTHETICAL complete gravity-shuffle distribution, NOT a source algorithmic timing search or minimax WDL. No other board sizes/K tested.
